item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Flag Pin
item_short_desc: Show your support and respect for the Police and Law Enforcement Officials with the Rothco's Thin Blue Line Flag Pin.
description: The Thin Blue Line is a symbol of respect and support for Police and Law Enforcement Officials; show your support with the Rothco's Thin Blue Line Flag Pin. This US flag pin is brass plated with a thin blue line in the center and measures 3/4" x 7/16".
